comparison.wav.recipe: The selected auditions concatenated A then B within each pair, with 0.45 seconds inside pairs and 1.0 second between pairs.

footsteps-pass-3-grounded.wav.recipe: The byte-preserved pass-3 grounded footsteps: two heel-and-toe contacts with restrained surface texture and no low thump.

footsteps-subtle-grounded.wav.recipe: Two quiet sole brushes with short, compressed midrange contacts and a faint toe release; the impact body is reduced and the level sits below pass 3.

stroller-wheels-pass-3-grounded.wav.recipe: The byte-preserved pass-3 grounded stroller wheels: dry wheel contacts, a rotation pulse and paired mechanism rattles.

stroller-wheels-quieter-grounded.wav.recipe: Very quiet dry wheel contacts with a faint rotation pulse and restrained single mechanism ticks; the level sits below the subtle steps.

level_strategy: Pass-3 files preserve their bytes; new footsteps and wheels use separate lower RMS targets, with wheels lower.
method: Handwritten procedural synthesis using standard-library oscillators, seeded noise, envelopes and filters.

reproducibility.guarantee: A scratch rebuild from the frozen generator is checked byte-for-byte against the generated package in the locked Python 3.14 environment.
reproducibility.limit: No blanket cross-platform bit-identical promise is made because platform math implementations may differ.

status: standalone audition; not installed in the game
